description.value:
Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Traits Signal, auditory, incapacitation, linguistic, mental

Choose a creature in range and ask it one question aloud. It attempts a Will save against your class DC. On a failure, it must answer aloud, in a language it shares with you, truthfully and completely to the best of its knowledge; it cannot mislead by omission, answer a different question, or claim ignorance it does not have. On a success, it is unaffected. Either way, everyone in range heard you ask, and everyone in range hears whether it answered.

cinderfall.incomplete: Same compulsion-effect reasoning as Riot and The Long Wave, but as a **feat** rather than a spell — treated as INCOMPLETE rather than SKIP/REAL since it isn't covered by the spell-convention statistic (P3 only measured spells) and no real player-feat precedent for "forces a truthful spoken answer" was found in the time available.
